_about: Every string a player reads, written before the build against TONE.md. Implement each string exactly as written. Values in braces are placeholders that the page fills from core or from data; _placeholders says where each comes from. Keys that begin with an underscore are instructions and are never shown to a player.

_placeholders.hash: the build hash stamped by packaging/package-web.sh
the current binding for that action, from data/controls.json or the player's saved bindings
_placeholders.left_keys, right_keys: the bound keys for that seat, joined in binding order
_placeholders.opponent: opponents.<id>.name, for the start of a sentence or a heading
_placeholders.opponent_mid: opponents.<id>.name_mid, for the middle of a sentence
_placeholders.part: parts.<id>, for the part the deciding cut crossed, as reported by core
_placeholders.delay_ms: the match's input delay in ticks, converted to milliseconds by core
_placeholders.tick: the first tick whose checksums differed, from the lockstep
_placeholders.pause_s, reach_pct, horizon_ms, reaction: derived from that opponent's entry in data/pilots.json; never typed
_placeholders.theirs, ours: the version in the file and the version this build reads
_placeholders.seconds: the time limit of a quick requirement, from data/road.json
_placeholders.cm: a distance in a tutorial goal, from data/tutorial.json
_placeholders.speed: a tutorial goal's speed in metres a second, converted by core from cm a tick in data/tutorial.json
_placeholders.first, second: the names of the two opponents a comparison mission pairs
_placeholders.n: which task of a comparison mission this is
_placeholders.mission: the name of a tutorial mission: the first component it teaches, or its two opponents
_placeholders.region: road.region.<row>, the name of a row of the arcade mode tree
_placeholders.won: how many fights in a chapter of arcade mode the player has won
_placeholders.count: how many requirements a level of the road's tree has, from data/road.json
_placeholders.companion: opponents.<id>.name of the opponent at the player's back on a flanked stop, from data/road.json
_placeholders.target_mid: opponents.<id>.name_mid of the locked fight a next goal opens, chosen by core (content::road::next_goal)

ink.means: what a fighter spills when cut, and loses the round by running out of

round.means: one exchange, ended by a fighter who cannot continue

match.means: rounds played until one fighter has won enough of them

replay.means: a file that plays a match back

save file.means: a file holding arcade mode progress and settings

room code.means: the short code a host sends a friend

input delay.means: the time between a key press and its effect in an online match

arcade mode.means: the mode where the player fights down a tree of opponents

game.name: Vagrancy
game.loading_error: The game could not load. Reload the page and try again.
game.fallback: This game needs JavaScript and WebAssembly to run.

road.label: Arcade mode
road.desc: Fight down a tree of opponents. A fight opens when you meet its requirements, such as beating the opponents above it.

local.label: Play at one keyboard
local.desc: Two players share this keyboard and fight each other.

online.label: Play a friend online
online.desc: One of you hosts a match and the other joins it.

practice.label: Practice in the yard
practice.desc: Swing at a post that does not fight back. Use the yard to learn the keys.

tutorial.label: Tutorial
tutorial.desc: Learn the game through short missions on a map. Each mission teaches one idea and builds on one you already have.

replay.label: Load a replay
replay.desc: Open a replay file to watch that match again.

control.title: What you control
control.body: You control your fighter's sword arm. {key.shoulder_up} raises the arm at the shoulder and {key.shoulder_down} lowers it. {key.elbow_in} bends the elbow and {key.elbow_out} straightens it. A joint keeps turning while you hold its key, so a swing depends on when you press and when you let go.
control.legs: Your fighter's legs keep it upright without your help. {key.step_left} and {key.step_right} take a slow step, and faster movement comes from the sword.

sword.title: The sword is solid
sword.body: The sword does not bend, and it cannot pass through the ground or through another sword. That lets you use it to move as well as to cut: plant the tip in the ground and straighten your arm, and the sword pushes your fighter into the air.

swing.title: A swing adds speed
swing.body: Swinging the sword pulls your whole fighter along with it. If you keep swinging in the same direction, your fighter moves faster, up to a limit.

cut.title: What a blade does
cut.body: When a blade touches a fighter, it cuts straight across the part it touched, and the part beyond the cut drops off. A fighter's own blade does not cut that fighter.

ink.title: Ink
ink.body: A cut that does not end the round spills ink until the round ends, and a larger cut spills it faster. The meter above each fighter shows how much ink that fighter has left.

end.title: How a round ends
end.body: A round ends when a fighter cannot continue: a cut crosses the neck, the head or the heart, or the fighter runs out of ink.

match.title: How a match ends
match.body: The first fighter to win {rounds_to_win} rounds wins the match. Both fighters are restored between rounds.

files.title: Replays and save files
files.body: You can download a match as a replay. Loading the replay plays the same match again, input for input. In Settings, you can download your arcade mode progress as a save file.

step.shoulder: Start with the shoulder. Hold {key.shoulder_up} to raise the arm, then let go. The sword is heavy, so the arm keeps moving for a moment after you release the key.
step.elbow: Next, the elbow. Hold {key.elbow_out} to straighten the arm and {key.elbow_in} to bend it. A straight arm reaches farther.
step.cut: Cut the post. A blade cuts the part it touches, so a swing that reaches the post is enough.
step.plant: Plant the sword. Point the tip at the ground, then straighten your arm. The sword cannot go into the ground, so the push lifts your fighter instead.
step.swing: Build speed. Swing in one direction several times without stopping. Each swing adds to the one before it, which is how you cross the yard quickly or leave the ground.
step.move: Move. Hold {key.step_left} or {key.step_right}, and the ground carries your fighter that way.
step.jump: Jump. Press {key.jump} to leave the ground. You can press it once more in the air, and you get that second jump back when you land.
step.air_jump: Push off the air. Your second jump works as if your fighter bounced off a wall you cannot see. Hold {key.step_left} or {key.step_right} as you press {key.jump} to push off toward that side, or hold neither to push straight up. The jump turns a fall into a rise at the same speed, so a jump late in a fall goes higher than one at the top.
step.stand: Get up. If your fighter is knocked off its feet but still has both legs, press {key.stand} to stand up where you are.
step.dodge: Dodge. Press {key.dodge}, and for a moment no blade can cut your fighter, so an attack can pass through you. Your own blade cuts nothing during that moment either.
step.roll: Roll. Hold {key.step_left} or {key.step_right} as you press {key.dodge}, and your fighter rolls that way along the ground. With neither held, your fighter dodges in place.
step.air_dodge: Dodge in the air. Press {key.dodge} while you are off the ground, and your fighter is carried sideways in the direction you hold. This uses up your second jump, so save it for when you need to get out of the way.
step.cooldown: After a dodge, there is a short wait before you can dodge again, so choose when to use it.
step.block: Block. Swords are solid, so a blade that meets yours stops. Hold your sword in front of you to stop a swing before it reaches you.
step.ink: Watch the ink. A cut that does not end the round leaves a stump that spills ink until the round ends. The meters at the top show how much ink each fighter has left.
step.throw: Throw the sword. Swing, then press {key.throw} to let go. The sword flies on as fast as the swing was moving, and cuts what it reaches until it first touches the ground. After that it cuts nothing. In a match you get it back at the next round; in the yard, the button that stands the post back up gives it back too.

practice.review: new: practice.step.move, jump, air_jump, stand, dodge, roll, air_dodge, cooldown, block, ink, and hud.keys

hud.keys: Your keys: {key.shoulder_up} and {key.shoulder_down} turn the shoulder, {key.elbow_in} and {key.elbow_out} bend and straighten the elbow, {key.step_left} and {key.step_right} move, {key.jump} jumps, {key.dodge} dodges, {key.stand} stands you up and {key.throw} throws your sword.

left.name: Indigo
left.described: Indigo, the solid figure on the left

right.name: Ochre
right.described: Ochre, the striped figure on the right

road.win_neck: You won the round. Your blade cut across {opponent_mid}'s {part}.
road.win_heart: You won the round. Your blade cut across {opponent_mid}'s heart.
road.win_ink: You won the round. {opponent} ran out of ink.
road.win_self: You won the round. {opponent}'s own blade made the cut that ended it.
road.lose_neck: You lost the round. {opponent}'s blade cut across your {part}.
road.lose_heart: You lost the round. {opponent}'s blade cut across your heart.
road.lose_ink: You lost the round. You ran out of ink, and the cut to your {part} spilled the most.
road.lose_self: You lost the round. Your own blade cut across your {part}.
road.match_win: You won the match, {wins} rounds to {losses}.
road.match_lose: You lost the match, {losses} rounds to {wins}.

versus.neck: {winner} won the round. {winner}'s blade cut across {loser}'s {part}.
versus.heart: {winner} won the round. {winner}'s blade cut across {loser}'s heart.
versus.ink: {winner} won the round. {loser} ran out of ink.
versus.self: {winner} won the round. {loser}'s own blade made the cut that ended it.

results.draw: Neither fighter won the round. Both stopped at the same moment, so the round is played again.
results.key_hint: Press {key} to choose the first button.

condition.deep_ink: Your opponent starts each round with twice the usual ink.
condition.light: Gravity is half its usual strength here, so jumps go higher and falls are slower.

req.headshot: Beat {opponent_mid}, ending a round with a cut across the head.
req.untouched: Beat {opponent_mid}, winning a round without being cut.

road.flawless: You have beaten {opponent_mid} without losing a round.
road.cleared: You have won this fight. You can fight {opponent_mid} again.
road.companion: {companion} stands behind you, carrying a {weapon}. The round ends when you can no longer fight, or when neither of them can.

scarecrow.name: The Scarecrow
scarecrow.place: A rice field outside the first village.
scarecrow.does: The scarecrow stands still and does not fight back.
scarecrow.try: Cut it anywhere first, to see how a cut works. Then aim for the neck, because a cut there ends the round.

gatekeeper.name: The Gatekeeper
gatekeeper.place: A toll gate, with the list of tolls posted beside it.
gatekeeper.does: The gatekeeper holds his sword out in front of him and keeps it there without swinging. Swords are solid, so your blade stops when it meets his.
gatekeeper.try: Try going over his blade or under it, toward the part of him the sword does not cover, because a swing into the blade stops there.

thresher.name: The Thresher
thresher.place: A threshing floor behind a farmhouse.
thresher.does: The thresher repeats the same overhead swing, with a pause of about {pause_s} seconds after each one.
thresher.try: Stay out of reach and count the pause. Move in after a swing has passed, while the blade is still low.

ferryman.name: The Ferryman
ferryman.place: A ferry landing on a riverbank.
ferryman.does: The ferryman's blade is about {reach_pct} percent longer than yours, so when you both swing level, his reaches you first. It is also heavier, so he takes longer to start a swing and to stop one.
ferryman.try: Let him swing first. While his heavy blade is still traveling, you have time to move and he does not.

vaulter.name: The Vaulter
vaulter.place: A dry riverbed with a hard clay floor.
vaulter.does: The vaulter plants her sword, lifts herself over you, and cuts downward as she passes, so her attacks usually come from above.
vaulter.try: Watch where she plants her sword. While the tip is in the ground, it is not pointed at you, and her path is already chosen.

windmill.name: The Windmill
windmill.place: A crossroads on a hill, in a steady wind.
windmill.does: The windmill keeps swinging without stopping. He builds speed the way you can, by swinging in one direction, and then drifts toward you with the blade turning.
windmill.try: Try meeting his blade with yours. Swords are solid, so a firm block stops the turn, and he needs time to build the speed again.

sampler.name: The Sampler
sampler.place: A tea house, with cups laid out along the counter.
sampler.does: The sampler watches the first round without attacking. After that, she repeats what you did in the previous round, mirrored.
sampler.try: What you do in one round is what you face in the next, so choose moves you know how to answer.

reader.name: The Reader
reader.place: An open gate at the edge of a town.
reader.does: Before the reader moves, she tries several moves a short way ahead and picks one. She looks about {horizon_ms} milliseconds into the future, and she acts on what she saw {reaction_ms} milliseconds ago.
reader.try: She does not look further ahead than that. Try a move that looks harmless at first and changes late, because the change comes after the point she checked.

drover.name: The Drover
drover.place: A cattle track between two stone walls.
drover.does: The drover walks straight at you and, once you are in reach, swings low at your legs. He does not guard.
drover.try: Try meeting him above the sweep. A jump or a high cut lands while his blade is still low.

lamplighter.name: The Lamplighter
lamplighter.place: A street lined with iron lamps.
lamplighter.does: The lamplighter holds her sword high and waits. When you come close she thrusts, and if you come closer still she steps back.
lamplighter.try: Draw the thrust, step out of its way, and come in under her high blade while her arm is still out.

cooper.name: The Cooper
cooper.does: The cooper jumps at you and cuts as he comes down. If he lands badly, he gets up before he does anything else.
cooper.try: Step aside as he leaves the ground, and cut as he lands.

bellringer.name: The Bellringer
bellringer.place: A bell tower at the edge of a village.
bellringer.does: The bellringer spins his sword and walks into you with it turning. When your point comes near his head, he dodges away and starts again.
bellringer.try: His dodge leaves him a moment with a still blade. Strike as he comes back in, before the sword is turning again.

courier.name: The Courier
courier.place: A relay station with a pile of parcels by the door.
courier.does: The courier keeps her distance and backs away when you come close. Now and then she rolls straight through your guard and cuts as she comes out of the roll.
courier.try: Her roll ends close to you, so keep your blade where she will be standing when it ends.

ropewalker.name: The Ropewalker
ropewalker.place: A rope strung between two poles over a dry ditch.
ropewalker.does: The ropewalker fights from the air. She jumps, pushes off the air toward you, and cuts downward as she falls.
ropewalker.try: Hold your sword above you as she comes down, because a blade that meets yours stops.

salt_trader.name: The Salt Trader
salt_trader.place: A salt warehouse with sacks stacked on crates.
salt_trader.does: The salt trader waits behind a high guard. When your point comes near her body, she dodges through you and cuts. When you dodge, she cuts where you are.
salt_trader.try: She waits for your attacks and answers them. Bring your point close to draw her dodge, then strike as it ends.

smith.name: The Smith
smith.place: A forge with an anvil beside the fire.
smith.does: The smith plants his sword and vaults over you, or jumps and pushes off the air to cut down at you. When your point comes at his head he dodges, and when he is knocked down he stands up at once.
smith.try: He spends much of his time in the air. Try cutting at him as he lands, once his second jump is used up.

archivist.name: The Archivist
archivist.place: A record office with ledgers on the shelves.
archivist.does: The archivist dodges most attacks that come at her head. Otherwise she tries several moves a short way ahead before she chooses. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
archivist.try: Attack her legs and body, because those are the cuts she does not dodge.

watchman.name: The Watchman
watchman.place: A gatehouse at the end of a bridge.
watchman.does: The watchman cuts at you when you leave the ground, dodges attacks at his head, jumps and pushes off the air, and stands up at once when knocked down. Between those, he tries moves a short way ahead. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
watchman.try: He punishes a jump. Try staying on the ground with your guard up, so that he has to come to you.

dyer.name: The Dyer
dyer.place: A dye works where the river runs blue below the vats.
dyer.does: When you come close, the dyer often sweeps low at your legs, and when your point comes at her body she often dodges back. Otherwise she looks a short way ahead before she chooses. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
dyer.try: Her sweep stays low. Meet it from above, or jump it and cut as you come down.

potter.name: The Potter
potter.place: A kiln yard with rows of pots drying in the sun.
potter.does: When you are close, the potter often thrusts. Otherwise he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
potter.try: A thrust leaves his arm out straight. Step aside from it, then cut before the arm comes back.

carpenter.name: The Carpenter
carpenter.place: A half-built house with its roof beams in place.
carpenter.does: Now and then, the carpenter plants her sword and vaults at you. Otherwise she looks a short way ahead before she chooses. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
carpenter.try: Once her tip goes into the ground, her path is chosen. Be somewhere else when she lands.

mason.name: The Mason
mason.place: A quarry where stone is cut into blocks.
mason.does: While you are far away, the mason waits behind his guard, and when his ink runs low he backs off. Close in, he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
mason.try: Try cutting him early. Once his ink is low he backs away, and he is easier to corner than to meet head on.

weaver.name: The Weaver
weaver.place: A weaving shed with a loom by the window.
weaver.does: When your point comes at her body, the weaver sometimes dodges in through your attack, and now and then she spins her sword as she closes. Otherwise she looks a short way ahead before she chooses. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
weaver.try: Her dodge brings her toward you. Feint at her body to draw it, and have your blade where she comes out.

falconer.name: The Falconer
falconer.place: A mews on a hillside, where falcons are kept.
falconer.does: Now and then, the falconer jumps, pushes off the air toward you, and cuts down as he falls. Otherwise he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
falconer.try: Hold your sword above you when he leaves the ground, because a blade that meets yours stops.

boatwright.name: The Boatwright
boatwright.place: A slipway with a hull resting on blocks.
boatwright.does: When you come in range, the boatwright thrusts, and she often steps back out of reach straight after. Otherwise she looks a short way ahead before she chooses. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
boatwright.try: She gives ground after a thrust. Follow her as she steps back, while her arm is still coming in.

brewer.name: The Brewer
brewer.place: A brewery yard stacked with kegs.
brewer.does: When you leave the ground near him, the brewer cuts overhead. Otherwise he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
brewer.try: He punishes a jump. Stay on the ground near him, and save your jumps for getting away.

herbalist.name: The Herbalist
herbalist.place: A herb garden beside a greenhouse.
herbalist.does: The herbalist dodges away from many attacks at her head, and backs off when her ink runs low. Otherwise she looks a short way ahead before she chooses. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
herbalist.try: Aim at her body and legs, because she does not dodge those.

cartographer.name: The Cartographer
cartographer.place: A survey camp with instruments on a folding table.
cartographer.does: Before the cartographer moves, he tries several moves a short way ahead and picks one. He looks about {horizon_ms} milliseconds into the future, and he acts on what he saw {reaction_ms} milliseconds ago.
cartographer.try: He looks further ahead than the reader. Try a move that starts slowly and finishes fast, which is the kind he misjudges.

magistrate.name: The Magistrate
magistrate.place: A courtroom with a raised bench.
magistrate.does: The magistrate dodges most attacks at her head and many at her body. Otherwise she looks a short way ahead before she chooses. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
magistrate.try: Her dodges carry her away from you. Attack, let her dodge, and be closer when she stops.

abbot.name: The Abbot
abbot.place: A mountain temple at the top of a long stair.
abbot.does: When you leave the ground near him, the abbot cuts overhead, and he dodges away from most attacks at his head. Otherwise he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
abbot.try: Fight him on the ground and aim low, because he answers a jump and dodges at his head.

warden.name: The Warden
warden.does: The warden dodges most attacks at her head, and now and then she vaults at you on her sword. Otherwise she looks a short way ahead before she chooses. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
warden.try: Once her tip goes into the ground, her path is chosen. Step aside and cut as she lands.

hermit.name: The Hermit
hermit.place: A cave above the tree line.
hermit.does: The hermit waits for you to come to him, and dodges away from most attacks at his head. Close in, he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
hermit.try: He will not come to you. Approach with your guard up, and attack his body.

tanner.name: The Tanner
tanner.place: A tannery downwind of the town.
tanner.does: Before the tanner moves, she tries several moves a short way ahead and picks one. She looks about {horizon_ms} milliseconds into the future, and she acts on what she saw {reaction_ms} milliseconds ago.
tanner.try: She reacts quickly. Try a steady guard, which does better against her than a feint.

tinker.name: The Tinker
tinker.place: A cart of pots and pans by the roadside.
tinker.does: The tinker walks toward you with a short sword and swings it overhead, resting about {pause_s} seconds between swings.
tinker.try: His sword is short. Stay beyond its reach, and cut as the swing ends.

pilgrim.name: The Pilgrim
pilgrim.place: A roadside shrine with an offering box.
pilgrim.does: The pilgrim stays where she is and swings a curved blade overhead, resting about {pause_s} seconds between swings.
pilgrim.try: The curved blade reaches wide but not far. Let the swing pass, then step in.

knife_grinder.name: The Knife Grinder
knife_grinder.place: A grinding wheel mounted on a handcart.
knife_grinder.does: The knife grinder walks toward you swinging a wavy kris overhead, resting about {pause_s} seconds between swings.
knife_grinder.try: The kris cuts along each of its bends, so keep clear of its whole length and not its tip alone.

ox_herd.name: The Ox Herd
ox_herd.place: A muddy pasture by a field gate.
ox_herd.does: The ox herd walks at you and, once you are in reach, sweeps low with a forked blade. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
ox_herd.try: His prongs sweep low. Meet them from above, or jump over them.

eel_fisher.name: The Eel Fisher
eel_fisher.place: A weir on the river, with eel traps along the bank.
eel_fisher.does: The eel fisher holds a trident high and thrusts when you come close. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
eel_fisher.try: A trident reaches with its prongs. Step aside from a thrust, then come in under her high guard.

bargeman.name: The Bargeman
bargeman.place: A barge tied up at a lock.
bargeman.does: The bargeman's longsword is about {reach_pct} percent longer than your sword. It is heavy, so he takes longer to start a swing and to stop one.
bargeman.try: Let him swing first. While his heavy blade is still traveling, you have time to move and he does not.

rice_broker.name: The Rice Broker
rice_broker.place: A rice exchange where the day's prices are chalked on a board.
rice_broker.does: The rice broker often spins a scimitar as he closes in. Otherwise he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
rice_broker.try: A spinning curved blade is hard to meet head on. Block it, then strike while he builds speed again.

bell_founder.name: The Bell Founder
bell_founder.place: A foundry yard with a bell cooling in a sand pit.
bell_founder.does: Now and then, the bell founder plants a kris and vaults at you. She cuts overhead when you are close, and otherwise keeps her guard up. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
bell_founder.try: Her vault follows a path she has already chosen. Be somewhere else when she lands.

porter.name: The Porter
porter.does: The porter sometimes sweeps low with a forked blade. Otherwise he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
porter.try: Try jumping his sweep and cutting as you come down.

lacquerer.name: The Lacquerer
lacquerer.place: A workshop lined with drying trays.
lacquerer.does: The lacquerer dodges away from many attacks at her head, and thrusts a trident when you are close. Otherwise she looks a short way ahead before she chooses. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
lacquerer.try: Aim at her body, which she does not dodge, and stay clear of the thrust.

post_rider.name: The Post Rider
post_rider.place: A relay stable with horses in the stalls.
post_rider.does: The post rider carries a longsword and closes in to use it. Otherwise he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
post_rider.try: His reach is longer than yours. Get inside it, where the long blade is slow to turn.

paper_maker.name: The Paper Maker
paper_maker.place: A paper mill with sheets hung up to dry.
paper_maker.does: The paper maker carries a short sword. Before she moves, she tries several moves a short way ahead and picks one. She looks about {horizon_ms} milliseconds into the future, and she acts on what she saw {reaction_ms} milliseconds ago.
paper_maker.try: Her sword is short. Keep your distance and let your reach do the work.

gambler.name: The Gambler
gambler.place: A back room with a card table.
gambler.does: The gambler dodges away from most attacks at his head. Otherwise he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
gambler.try: He dodges attacks at his head, so aim at his body and legs.

monk.name: The Monk
monk.place: A temple courtyard with a raked gravel garden.
monk.does: When you leave the ground near her, the monk cuts overhead, and she sometimes dodges in through attacks at her body. Otherwise she looks a short way ahead before she chooses. She reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after she sees your blade move.
monk.try: Stay on the ground, and keep your blade where she will be when her dodge ends.

general.name: The General
general.place: A command tent with maps spread on the table.
general.does: The general carries a longsword and dodges away from most attacks at his head. Otherwise he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
general.try: Get inside his reach and aim at his body, because he dodges most attacks at his head.

duelist.name: The Duelist
duelist.place: A walled garden with a single gate.
duelist.does: The duelist carries a kris. Before she moves, she tries several moves a short way ahead and picks one. She looks about {horizon_ms} milliseconds into the future, and she acts on what she saw {reaction_ms} milliseconds ago.
duelist.try: She reacts faster than almost any other opponent. Try a steady guard, which does better against her than a feint.

roofer.name: The Roofer
roofer.place: A row of tiled roofs at different heights.
roofer.does: The roofer carries a scimitar and prefers high ground. When a ledge is above her, she sometimes jumps up and stands on it, and from there she swings overhead at you below. On the ground she sweeps low.
roofer.try: Try staying out from under her ledge. To reach you, she has to come down and fight from the ground.

well_digger.name: The Well digger
well_digger.place: A half-dug well in a courtyard, with a bucket on a rope.
well_digger.does: The well digger carries a kris and walks straight at you. Close in, he sweeps low or bounces in with a thrust, and between attacks he holds his blade low.
well_digger.try: His attacks come from below. Keep your blade low enough to meet them, and keep the tinker in view behind you.

charcoal_burner.name: The Charcoal burner
charcoal_burner.place: A clearing of smoking earth mounds where charcoal is made.
charcoal_burner.does: The charcoal burner carries a forked blade and waits with it raised, backing away if you come close. Once the drover has reached you, she steps in and thrusts from the other side.
charcoal_burner.try: Try beating the drover quickly, because the charcoal burner waits to attack until the drover is keeping you busy.

tea_picker.name: The Tea picker
tea_picker.place: A terraced tea garden with raised stone walls.
tea_picker.does: The tea picker carries a short sword. He dodges away from about half the attacks at his head, and from close range he often dodges in through yours. When a ledge is above him, he sometimes jumps up and stands on it. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
tea_picker.try: His sword is short. Stay a little beyond it, and cut as his dodge ends.

bridge_keeper.name: The Bridge keeper
bridge_keeper.place: A wooden footbridge over a canal.
bridge_keeper.does: The bridge keeper carries a trident and climbs onto the bridge when he can. From above, he strikes overhead at anyone below him. Otherwise he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
bridge_keeper.try: Fight him away from the bridge, or get up onto it with him, so that your head is not under his trident.

kite_maker.name: The Kite maker
kite_maker.place: A hillside of terraces, with kites tied to a fence.
kite_maker.does: The kite maker carries a scimitar and climbs the terraces when she can. From higher ground she jumps down at you with a cut, and close in she sometimes bounces before she strikes. Otherwise she looks a short way ahead before she chooses.
kite_maker.try: Try taking the high terrace before she does, so that she has to come up to you.

net_mender.name: The Net mender
net_mender.place: A jetty hung with drying nets.
net_mender.does: The net mender carries a trident and keeps his distance until the courier has reached you. Then he looks a short way ahead and attacks from the other side. He sometimes dodges away from an attack at his head, and he reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
net_mender.try: He comes in when the courier arrives, so turn to face him then.

stone_cutter.name: The Stone cutter
stone_cutter.place: A quarry with a wooden crane for lifting blocks.
stone_cutter.does: The stone cutter carries a longsword, about {reach_pct} percent longer than your sword, and swings it overhead when you come within reach. Otherwise she looks a short way ahead before she chooses. The gatekeeper stands at your back with a trident held out.
stone_cutter.try: The gatekeeper waits for you. Fight the stone cutter first, and keep your back clear of the trident.

shrine_keeper.name: The Shrine keeper
shrine_keeper.place: A mountain shrine built on terraces.
shrine_keeper.does: The shrine keeper carries a sword and dodges away from about half the attacks at his head. When you stand above him, he climbs after you. Otherwise he looks a short way ahead before he chooses. He reacts about {reaction_ms} milliseconds after he sees your blade move.
shrine_keeper.try: Fight him on the ground, where he has no reason to climb.

toll_collector.name: The Toll collector
toll_collector.place: A toll gate on a mountain pass, with ledges cut into the rock.
toll_collector.does: The toll collector carries a kris. She dodges away from most attacks at her head, climbs a ledge when she is under one, and from above swings overhead at you. Otherwise she looks a short way ahead before she chooses.
toll_collector.try: Keep moving, so that she does not get to stand above you.

K01.name: Turning the shoulder
K01.when: You want the sword higher or lower.
K01.then: Hold a shoulder key, and the arm turns for as long as you hold it.

K02.name: Bending and straightening the elbow
K02.when: The target is nearer or farther than your blade.
K02.then: Straighten the elbow to reach farther, and bend it to pull the blade in.

K03.name: The sword carries on
K03.then: Let go of the key before the blade gets where you want it, because the heavy sword keeps turning the arm.

K04.name: Stepping
K04.when: You are too far from your opponent, or too close.
K04.then: Hold a step key, and the ground carries you that way while the legs keep you upright.

K05.name: Jumping
K05.when: You need to leave the ground.
K05.then: Press jump. You get one jump from the ground.

K06.name: The bounce in the air
K06.when: You are in the air and still have your second jump.
K06.then: Press jump to bounce off the air, holding a direction to push that way; a jump late in a fall rises higher, because the fall turns into a rise at the same speed.

K07.name: Getting up
K07.when: You are knocked down and still have both legs.

K08.name: Dodging
K08.when: A blade is about to touch you.
K08.then: Press dodge so that the touch comes during the moment when no blade can cut you. Your own blade cuts nothing in that moment either.

K09.name: Rolling
K09.when: You want to dodge and change place on the ground.
K09.then: Hold a direction as you press dodge.

K10.name: Dodging in the air
K10.when: You are in the air and need to get out of the way.
K10.then: Press dodge to be carried sideways, at the cost of your second jump.

K11.name: The wait after a dodge
K11.then: Expect a short wait before you can dodge again, so choose when to dodge instead of pressing again.

K12.name: Blocking
K12.when: A swing is coming at you.
K12.then: Put your blade in its path, because swords are solid and a blade that meets yours stops.

K13.name: What a cut is
K13.when: Your moving blade touches a part of a fighter.
K13.then: The blade cuts straight across that part where it touched, and what lies beyond the cut drops off; a slow blade does not cut.

K14.name: Where a cut ends the round
K14.then: Aim across the neck, the head or the heart, because a cut there ends the round.

K15.name: Ink
K15.when: A cut lands somewhere that does not end the round.
K15.then: The stump spills ink until the round ends, faster for a larger cut, and a fighter who runs out of ink loses the round.

K16.name: Swinging for speed
K16.when: You need to cross ground fast or leave it.
K16.then: Swing in one direction again and again, because each swing adds speed to your whole fighter.

K17.name: Planting the sword
K17.when: You want to rise or vault.
K17.then: Put the tip on the ground and straighten the arm; the sword cannot go into the ground, so the push lifts you.

K18.name: Reach
K18.when: The opponent's blade is longer than yours.
K18.then: Let them swing first and move in while their blade travels, because a longer, heavier blade is slower to start and to stop.

K19.name: The opening after a committed move
K19.when: The opponent has finished a swing, a thrust or a landing.
K19.then: Attack in that moment, before they can move again.

K20.name: A path already chosen
K20.when: The opponent is in the air or has planted the sword.
K20.then: Move to where they are not going, and cut where they land.

K21.name: Getting around a guard
K21.when: The opponent holds the sword out in front.
K21.then: Go over or under the blade, toward the part it does not cover.

K22.name: Stopping a turning blade
K22.when: The opponent keeps the sword turning.
K22.then: Meet it with a firm block, then strike while they build speed again.

K23.name: High against low
K23.when: An attack comes low, or a guard sits high, or an overhead waits for your jump.
K23.then: Answer from the other height: over a sweep, under a high guard, and on the ground against an overhead.

K24.name: Aim where they do not defend
K24.when: The opponent dodges attacks at one part of the body.
K24.then: Aim at another part that still ends the round or drains it.

K25.name: Drawing a move
K25.when: The opponent answers a threat rather than attacking.
K25.then: Make the threat, let them answer, and strike as the answer ends.

K26.name: Your own moves returned
K26.when: The opponent copies what you did last round.
K26.then: Do this round what you know how to answer next round.

K27.name: A late change
K27.when: The opponent looks a short time ahead before choosing.
K27.then: Start a move that looks harmless and change it late.

K28.name: Inside their reaction
K28.when: The opponent reacts some time after you move.
K28.then: Finish what you start before they can answer it.

K29.name: Distance
K29.when: The opponent keeps away from you, or waits for you to come.
K29.then: Close in with your guard up, and keep your blade where they will be.

K30.name: A guard above
K30.when: The opponent comes down at you from the air.
K30.then: Hold your sword above you, because a blade that meets yours stops.

K31.name: Light gravity
K31.then: Jump later and expect to hang longer, for you and for them.

K32.name: An opponent with more ink
K32.when: The opponent has twice your ink.
K32.then: Go for a cut that ends the round rather than waiting for them to run dry.

I1.name: Winning a round
I1.when: A round starts against an opponent who does not fight back.
I1.then: Close the distance and land a cut that ends the round.

I2.name: Winning a match
I2.then: Find what they commit to, answer it, and do that again in the next round.

S1.name: Watch before you commit
S1.then: Watch what they repeat before you attack.

S2.name: Compare two opponents
S2.when: Two opponents differ in one thing.
S2.then: Find that difference, and change the part of your plan it touches.

kc_edge.K01_K03: Letting go early is the same shoulder key, timed against the weight of the sword.
kc_edge.K01_K13: A cut needs a moving blade, and the shoulder is what moves it.
kc_edge.K02_K13: The elbow decides whether the blade reaches the part you aim at.
kc_edge.K13_K14: A cut that ends the round is an ordinary cut across a different part.
kc_edge.K13_K15: A cut that does not end the round still costs ink.
kc_edge.K01_K12: A block is the shoulder holding the blade in the path of a swing.
kc_edge.K12_K22: Stopping a turning blade is a block held against something that keeps coming.
kc_edge.K12_K30: A guard above is a block against a swing that comes down.
kc_edge.K12_K21: A guard that waits is a block you have to go around.
kc_edge.K05_K06: The second jump is the first with the ground replaced by a bounce.
kc_edge.K08_K09: A roll is a dodge with a direction held.
kc_edge.K08_K10: An air dodge is a dodge with the ground taken away.
kc_edge.K06_K10: An air dodge spends the second jump.
kc_edge.K08_K11: The wait comes after the dodge.
kc_edge.K01_K16: Speed comes from swinging the shoulder one way.
kc_edge.K02_K17: Straightening the arm is what pushes the planted tip.
kc_edge.K16_K17: A plant is a swing whose push goes into the ground.
kc_edge.K04_K29: Distance is your steps chosen against theirs.
kc_edge.K02_K18: Reach is your straightened arm measured against theirs.
kc_edge.K13_K19: An opening is worth something when you have a cut to land in it.
kc_edge.K19_K20: A jump or a plant is a committed move that lasts longer.
kc_edge.K17_K20: An opponent who plants has done what you can do, and their path is fixed until they land.
kc_edge.K19_K25: Drawing a move makes the opening instead of waiting for it.
kc_edge.K11_K25: The wait after their dodge is the opening a drawn dodge gives you.
kc_edge.K05_K23: A jump is one way over a low attack.
kc_edge.K12_K23: Meeting a sweep from above is a block from another height.
kc_edge.K14_K24: If one part that ends the round is defended, another still ends it.
kc_edge.K08_K24: Their dodge is the move you learned, used against you, so aim at a part that does not trigger it.
kc_edge.K19_K26: Your own last round is the committed move you face.
kc_edge.K19_K28: An opening lasts as long as they take to react.
kc_edge.K28_K27: Looking ahead is reacting early, and a late change lands past what they looked at.
kc_edge.K06_K31: Light gravity is the same jump with the fall slowed.
kc_edge.K15_K32: With twice the ink to drain, waiting for them to run dry takes twice as long.
kc_edge.K14_K32: A cut that ends the round does not depend on how much ink is left.
kc_edge.K04_I1: A round starts with closing the distance.
kc_edge.K14_I1: A round ends with a cut across the neck, the head or the heart.
kc_edge.I1_I2: A match is rounds won against someone who answers back.
kc_edge.K12_I2: Against someone who swings back, your blade is also your shield.
kc_edge.K19_I2: Against an opponent who fights back, rounds are won in the opening after a move they commit to.
kc_edge.S1_K19: Watching first shows which moves they commit to.
kc_edge.S1_K26: Watching your own round is how you see what comes back.
kc_edge.S2_K24: Comparing two opponents shows what changed, and so where to aim.
kc_edge.S2_K32: Comparing a fight with and without its condition shows what the condition changes.

kc_compare.c_swing_plant: The same push from the shoulder and the arm, sent into the air or into the ground.
kc_compare.p_jump_air_jump: A jump from the ground and a bounce off the air.
kc_compare.p_dodge_roll: A dodge in place and a dodge with a direction.
kc_compare.c_sweep: The same low sweep, with and without a dodge behind it.
kc_compare.c_overhead: An overhead waiting for your jump, with and without dodges.
kc_compare.c_opening: The opening after a swing and after a thrust.
kc_compare.c_aim: Dodges at the head with and without a search behind them.
kc_compare.c_above: A fall from the air with and without a search between attacks.
kc_compare.c_commit: A vault now and then, and a vault as the whole plan.
kc_compare.c_turning: A turning blade that drifts in, and one that dodges away.
kc_compare.c_draw: Drawing a thrust and drawing a dodge.
kc_compare.c_ink: A thrust with the usual ink behind it, and one with twice the ink.

goal.full_turn: Turn the sword a full circle around your shoulder.
goal.reach: Hold the tip {cm} cm in front of you.
goal.step: Move {cm} cm from where you started.
goal.air_jump: Jump again while you are in the air.
goal.air_dodge: Dodge while you are in the air.
goal.spill_cut: Make a cut that spills ink.
goal.clashes: Meet the opponent's blade with yours {count} times.
goal.speed: Swing until you are moving at {speed} metres a second.
goal.plant: Plant the sword and lift yourself {cm} cm, without the jump key.

sword.name: sword
sword.desc: Balanced in reach, weight and speed.

short_sword.name: short sword
short_sword.desc: Short and light. It turns quickly and reaches little.

scimitar.name: scimitar
scimitar.desc: A curved blade, shorter than the sword. The curve cuts along a wider arc.

kris.name: kris
kris.desc: A wavy blade, heavier than the sword, that cuts along each of its bends.

forked_blade.name: forked blade
forked_blade.desc: A heavy blade that splits into two prongs near the tip.

trident.name: trident
trident.desc: A center blade with a prong on each side. It is the heaviest weapon you can carry.

flat.name: Open ground
flat.desc: Flat ground with nothing to stand on.

ledges.name: Ledges
ledges.desc: A raised ledge at each end. Jump, and press {key.stand} while you are above a ledge, to stand on it.

bridge.name: Bridge
bridge.desc: A raised walkway across the middle. Jump, and press {key.stand} while you are above it, to stand on it.

tiers.name: Terraces
tiers.desc: A low terrace at each side and a high one in the middle. Jump, and press {key.stand} while you are above a terrace, to stand on it.
